reason: I'm not sure yet who I'd hire for the flat, and I'd want to see the builders and the contract before paying anyone. A platform fee on top of the builder's price just looks like one more cost to me.
objection: If every builder bids on the same brief, I still have no way to tell whether a higher bid means better work or just a bigger markup, and the platform doesn't show me how it checks that.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing several real bids on my own flat's brief, side by side, with the price for each line item and a named builder I can check, all in my city.
